lesson: When two catalogs agree by exact ISBN and the field is empty, fill it in.

verdicts.correct: Right. Two catalogs found this exact ISBN and name the same publisher, and the only other edition on Open Library uses the same spelling. That is as sure as it gets.
verdicts.unsure: Understandable, but this one was safe: two catalogs agree by exact ISBN and the field was empty. When the meter says Strong and nothing contradicts it, filling in is the right move.
verdicts.wrong: Not this time. Both catalogs name Harvard University Press for this exact ISBN. When the sources agree that strongly, take their value.
